reference_answer: Artificial intelligence is the field of computing concerned with building systems that can perform tasks that normally require human intelligence.
Machine learning is a branch of artificial intelligence in which systems learn patterns from data to make predictions or decisions.
A database is an organized collection of data that can be stored, managed, retrieved, and updated electronically.
An algorithm is a finite sequence of well-defined steps used to solve a problem or perform a computation.
Cloud computing is the delivery of computing resources such as servers, storage, and software over a network on demand.
Basirar wucin gadi fanni ne na kwamfuta da ke gina tsarin da zai iya yin ayyukan da yawanci ke bukatar basirar dan Adam.
Koyon na'ura wani bangare ne na basirar wucin gadi inda tsarin kwamfuta ke koyon tsari daga bayanai domin yin hasashe ko yanke shawara.
Bayanan adana bayanai tarin bayanai ne da aka tsara domin a iya adanawa, sarrafawa, samu da sabunta su ta hanyar lantarki.
Algorithm jerin matakai ne da aka tsara a fili domin warware matsala ko aiwatar da lissafi.
Kwamfuta ta gajimare ita ce samar da albarkatun kwamfuta kamar sabar, ajiya da manhajoji ta hanyar hanyar sadarwa bisa bukata.

prompt: Gịnị bụ ọgụgụ isi mmadụ mere?
reference_answer: Ọgụgụ isi mmadụ mere bụ ngalaba kọmputa nke na-ewulite usoro nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ ndị na-achọkarị ọgụgụ isi mmadụ.
Mmụta igwe bụ ngalaba ọgụgụ isi mmadụ mere ebe usoro na-amụta ụkpụrụ site na data iji mee amụma ma ọ bụ mkpebi.
Nchekwa data bụ nchịkọta data a haziri nke enwere ike ịchekwa, jikwaa, weghachite ma melite n'ụzọ eletrọnịkị.
Algorithm bụ usoro nzọụkwụ akọwapụtara nke ọma nke a na-eji edozi nsogbu ma ọ bụ rụọ ọrụ mgbakọ.
Cloud computing bụ nnyefe akụrụngwa kọmputa dịka sava, nchekwa na ngwanrọ site na netwọkụ mgbe achọrọ ha.
Ọgbọ́n atọwọda jẹ́ ẹ̀ka ìmọ̀ kọ̀ǹpútà tí ń kọ́ àwọn ètò tí ó lè ṣe àwọn iṣẹ́ tí ó sábà máa ń nílò ọgbọ́n ènìyàn.
Ẹ̀kọ́ ẹrọ jẹ́ ẹ̀ka ọgbọ́n atọwọda tí ètò kọ̀ǹpútà ti ń kọ́ àwọn àpẹẹrẹ láti inú dátà láti ṣe àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ tàbí ìpinnu.
Ibi ipamọ dátà jẹ́ àkójọpọ̀ dátà tí a ṣètò tí a lè fi pamọ́, ṣàkóso, gba padà àti ṣe àtúnṣe ní ẹ̀rọ ayélujára.
Algorithm jẹ́ àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tí a ṣàlàyé dáadáa tí a ń lò láti yanju ìṣòro tàbí ṣe iṣiro.
Cloud computing jẹ́ fífi àwọn ohun èlò kọ̀ǹpútà bíi server, ibi ipamọ àti software hàn lórí nẹ́tíwọ̀ọ̀kì nígbà tí a bá nílò wọn.
